name: filing
description: SEC EDGAR filing index for US pool members (8-K, 10-Q, 10-K and amendments). One row per filing per symbol (share classes share a CIK).

columns.name: items
columns.description: 8-K items, comma-separated, e.g. 2.02,9.01; null for other forms.

columns.name: acceptance_datetime
columns.description: Acceptance time converted to UTC (see data-sources.md: the raw field is US/Eastern clock time).

columns.name: primary_document
columns.description: File name of the main document.
